traits.name: Breath of the Bog
traits.text: (aura, divine, enchantment, mental); 30 feet. A creature that begins its turn within the area feels as if its lungs were filling with water and must succeed at a DC 19 Fortitude save or be unable to speak or breathe. The creature can still hold its breath and can attempt a new saving throw at the end of its turn. A creature that succeeds is temporarily immune to breath of the bog for 24 hours.

traits.name: Rise Up
traits.text: ⬲ Requirements Initiative has not yet been rolled Trigger A creature walks on top of a bog mummy that lies buried in the mud or peat below Effect The bog mummy automatically notices the creature and Burrows before rolling initiative.

traits.name: Bog Rot
traits.text: (curse, disease, divine, necromancy, negative); Saving Throw DC 21 Fortitude. Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 minute) Stage 2 3d6 (3d6) negative damage and clumsy 1 (1 day)
